plan.summary: Flag six excerpt-only review files as wrongShow. Four NYC Theatre excerpts on The Heart (the-heart-off-broadway-2026, Laura Pels 2026) are quotes from the 2024 Broadway roundup for The Heart of Rock and Roll (heart-of-rock-and-roll-2024): the scraper took that roundup page because 'The Heart' is a word-for-word prefix of the longer title (GitHub issue #1018). The corpus sweep for the same class found two more: the Hollywood Reporter excerpt on Home (home-1970) is David Rooney's Fun Home review, and the BroadwayWorld excerpt on Titus Andronicus (titus-andronicus-off-broadway-2026) is Michael Dale's review of Gary: A Sequel to Titus Andronicus.
steps: Set wrongShow=true on the four nyc-theatre excerpt files under the-heart-off-broadway-2026 (NYT, NY Daily News, NY Theatre Guide, TheaterMania). The fifth (nypost--unknown.json) was already rejected wrong_show by the ensemble check.
Set wrongShow=true on home-1970/hollywood-reporter--david-rooney.json (bwwExcerpt names 'the haunting musical Fun Home')
Set wrongShow=true on titus-andronicus-off-broadway-2026/broadwayworld--michael-dale.json (bwwExcerpt names 'Gary: A Sequel to Titus Andronicus')

actions.description: Excerpt opens "The Heart of Rock and Roll' is not going to be the subject of think pieces": Jesse Green's 2024 NYT review of heart-of-rock-and-roll-2024, scraped from that show's NYC Theatre roundup. The Heart does not open until 2026-10-29.
Excerpt describes 'a modestly scaled and warm-hearted jukebox show' directed by Gordon Greenberg: the 2024 Daily News review of heart-of-rock-and-roll-2024, from the same wrong NYC Theatre roundup.
Excerpt mentions 'an 80s kid' and Corey Cott (Bobby in heart-of-rock-and-roll-2024): Gillian Russo's 2024 NYTG review of that show, from the same wrong NYC Theatre roundup.
Excerpt names 'The Heart of Rock and Roll' outright: the 2024 TheaterMania review of heart-of-rock-and-roll-2024, from the same wrong NYC Theatre roundup.
Excerpt is about 'the haunting musical Fun Home' (fun-home-2015), not David Storey's Home (1970). Excerpt-only file, url is a BWW people page.

Excerpt names 'Gary: A Sequel to Titus Andronicus' (gary-a-sequel-to-titus-andronicus-2019): Michael Dale's 2019 review of that show, not the 2026 Titus Andronicus. Excerpt-only file, url is a BWW people page.
